paragraphs: In Berakhot 55b: R' Akiva said in the name of R' Panda, who said in the name of R' Nahum; and Dikdukei Soferim brings several readings: R' Panana, or R' Parna.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: דק״ס is contextually Dikdukei Soferim; its variants are Hyman’s attributed report without fresh collation. All six personal-title abbreviations remain R', including Akiva, whose identity is not otherwise established here.
נה: gives 55b by the colon convention, without fresh named passage verification.

Panda/Panana/Parna retain distinct supplied forms; Panana replaces the unsupported extra syllable in old Pannana. Conventional vowels are not independent identity or vocalization evidence. Chain order Akiva→Panda→Nahum and alternative or are preserved.
